name: Code Name: Romance
source:
The terrible terror that happened 10 years ago,
Gathered a group of criminals, and named itself "Doomsday."
What is it that's hidden behind that mysterious day,
and the "unknown" who has been longing for you for so long!

What would you do if you are the daughter of a legendary agent,
and you are meant to be a hero and subdue the villain?
Find out in 🖤Code Name : Romance🖤

[Edited from [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.storytaco.p22client]Google Play[/url] description.]
translation:
10年前发生了可怕的恐怖事件，一群罪犯聚集起来，自称“末日”。
那个神秘日子背后隐藏着什么？那个长久以来一直思念你的“未知之人”又是谁？

如果你是传奇特工的女儿，注定要成为英雄并制服反派，你会怎么做？
来《Code Name: Romance》中寻找答案吧！🖤

[改编自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.storytaco.p22client]Google Play[/url]上的简介。]
